moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the most out of this guide, and how the machine is set up: Pentaho Data Integration with the GenAI plugin suite and its license, local Ollama models, PostgreSQL with pgvector, and Python.

moduleSummaries.title: AI Pipelines
moduleSummaries.summary: Key concepts behind LLM-powered pipelines: prompts, tokenization, embeddings, semantic search and transformers, tried hands-on in Python.

moduleSummaries.title: Documents to Text
moduleSummaries.summary: The GenAI plugin suite, and its first job: turning HTML pages, Word documents, PDFs and slides into text, and reading their metadata, with HTML Parser, Read Unstructured Document and Discover Metadata.

moduleSummaries.title: LLM Integration
moduleSummaries.summary: The AI Chat step on a local model: sentiment, data quality, enrichment, entity recognition with the NER Extractor and with an LLM, summaries of long documents with AI Segmentation, and multi-stage pipelines.

moduleSummaries.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
moduleSummaries.summary: Answer questions from your own documents: chunk them with AI Segmentation, embed them with Text to Vector, load pgvector with Vector Writer, then retrieve with Vector Search and answer with AI Chat, citing the sources.

moduleSummaries.title: LangExtract
moduleSummaries.summary: Structured extraction with source grounding: support tickets, clinical notes and contracts turned into rows in PostgreSQL through a local LangExtract service.

moduleSummaries.title: Agents and Tools
moduleSummaries.summary: The Model Context Protocol: call a server's tools with the MCP Client step or let AI Chat choose them, then deploy an agent as a service that a transformation calls.

moduleSummaries.title: Moving to Production
moduleSummaries.summary: What changes when the pipelines leave Spoon: the GenAI plugins and their license on every runtime, configuration by environment, the model server and vector store in production, reliability, monitoring and evaluation, and the RAG pipelines run and scheduled on Pentaho Server.

moduleSummaries.title: Capstone Project
moduleSummaries.summary: One project across the course: a support desk copilot that triages tickets, retrieves the right manual passages and drafts grounded replies into PostgreSQL.
